{{Top|leg}}
A '''Corrector''' was an elite [[Officer/Legends|officer]] within [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]]'s [[Daimanate|domain]]. Correctors were hardcore Daimanite [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith adepts]] who were assigned with carrying out law enforcement duties within Daiman's territories and enforcing the Sith Lord's twisted philosophy.

==History==
They carried [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] into combat and were known to target pieces of Daiman's "creation" that were deemed "imperfect". An example of this would be "correcting" a person who dared laugh at the ''"creator of all's" "eyes"'', [[Knel'char II]] and [[Knel'char III|III]], when the stars' orbits made Daiman appear cross-eyed.

==Behind the scenes==
Correctors first appeared as a plot element in [[John Jackson Miller]]'s stand-alone novel [[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']]. In an email, Miller confirmed that the Correctors were a separate organization from the [[Daimanate Sith trooper]]s, describing them as Lord Daiman's equivalent of the Jedi and priests.<ref name="Mail">{{EmailCite|email=File:John Jackson Miller email 1.jpg|creator=[[John Jackson Miller]]|date=2012-12-27}}</ref>
